moves.name: Straight punch
moves.notes: Fast check; high guard blocks; crouch evades. Hit advantage +2; block advantage -4 on first active tick.

moves.name: Body punch
moves.notes: Both guards block; whiff punishable. No automatic counter selection.

moves.name: Heavy cross
moves.notes: Long commitment; no cancellation on whiff.

moves.name: Low kick
moves.notes: Low guard required; standing guard loses to low.

moves.name: Overhead strike
moves.notes: Standing guard required; visibly distinct wind-up.

moves.name: Rising strike
moves.notes: Airborne hit triggers knockdown; no universal invulnerability.

moves.name: Air kick
moves.notes: One per jump; recovery runs in air; landing adds max(remaining,6) recovery ticks.

moves.name: Conference throw
moves.notes: Requires grounded target within 0.65m; held grab-break window 12 ticks; no injury close-up.

moves.name: Break throw
moves.notes: Both return to neutral at separated anchors. Available only during a telegraphed capture.

moves.name: Veto parry
moves.notes: Catches mid/high/overhead only; excludes low and throw. Success adds 24-tick attacker stagger and 8-tick defender recovery.

moves.name: Diplomatic shield
moves.notes: Absorbs one non-throw hit during active window; expires after hit. On absorption both recover for 12 ticks; no extra damage.

moves.name: Paperwork burst
moves.notes: Single short-range hit at 1.4m; paper particles are cosmetic; no projectile simulation in V1.

moves.name: Summit adjourned
moves.notes: Short lunge capped at 0.9m; scripted recovery pose; no camera cut until move resolves. V2 content.

moves.name: Forward dash
moves.notes: 0.8m displacement; no invulnerability; canonical root curve.

moves.name: Back dash
moves.notes: 0.75m retreat; no invulnerability; collision and arena bounds still apply.

moves.name: Jump
moves.notes: 32-tick flight; 0.9m peak; lateral travel up to 0.8m from held direction; no double jump.

moves.name: High guard
moves.notes: Active phase loops while held; regenerates stamina at 8/s; blocks high/mid/overhead.

moves.name: Low guard
moves.notes: Active phase loops while held; blocks low/mid; exposes overhead.

moves.name: Advance
moves.notes: Held state; 1.8m/s; ends on release, collision, or higher-priority legal input.

moves.name: Retreat
moves.input: A or D away from opponent
moves.notes: Held state; 1.45m/s; cannot exit arena.

moves.name: Crouch
moves.notes: Active phase loops; high attacks pass above canonical head volume; does not block automatically.

moves.name: Neutral idle
moves.notes: Loop; guaranteed legal fallback when actor is neutral. Never overrides hitstun.

requirements.acceptance: A new desktop-browser visitor enters an unranked match without an account.
All published avatars use the same mechanics and can select either V1 special.
Keyboard user can change settings, remap keys and exit every modal.
No WebGL 2 or no model service produces a usable explanation and alternative.
Focus loss pauses the simulation and clears held inputs.
Warming, unavailable and at-capacity services cannot display live-ready status.
Identical inputs and seed produce identical state checksums on tested platforms.
Move activation and recovery match the registered S/A/R ticks.
LOD, render rate and outfit changes do not change a hit result.
High/low guard and crouch interactions match every test matrix entry.
Simultaneous damage, knockout and timer ties use the documented rules.
No route exceeds three damaging strikes or bypasses recovery illegally.
Both orientations resolve the 12-tick escape window correctly.
Insufficient stamina or meter always masks the relevant move.
Swapping avatar ID changes no combat constant or collision envelope.
Held/repeated/competing inputs obey the five-tick buffer and fixed priority.
Real SDK output maps to the versioned response contract; missing fields are not invented.
Standard snapshots are exactly 12 ticks old, not current values with an old timestamp.
Requests contain no keyboard queue, future choices, identity or political fields.
Unknown, unaffordable and no-longer-legal actions cannot execute.
One in-flight request per fighter; six Hz default, eight Hz hard cap.
Wrong epoch/round/request, expired and duplicate results are discarded.
Failures idle or pause; baseline mode is visibly labelled and recorded.
A release identifies immutable weights, tokenizer, SDK and candidate-generation revisions.
Held-out comparisons include no-history and conventional-policy baselines.
Server model timing is not represented as end-to-end response time.
Public copy distinguishes rolling-history adaptation from weight updates.
Tokenizer budget tests pass without truncation; candidate coverage and pruning reasons are logged.
Every published likeness has source/usage records and a reviewed neutral feature sheet.
Front, profile, three-quarter, blinks and all 24 morphs pass review.
Bone/socket names, bind pose, scale and <=90 joint limit validate.
Curated clip matrix passes penetration and 2cm/3cm contact targets.
Each selected character meets its tier geometry and <=12MiB standard-transfer target.
62 shared V1 clips and four presentation clips per selected leader are present.
Arena is within bounds/budget and contains no unapproved official branding.
Cloth, debris, cameras and effects cannot alter collision or damage.
Actor and sound licences recorded; no real-leader voice clone; overlap mix does not clip.
Replay never invokes model inference and matches recorded applied actions.
Build/moveset/model/asset versions retained; incompatible replay is rejected clearly.
Five-match/100MiB storage bounds enforced; user deletion works.
Export contains HUD/disclosure even though the live accessible HUD is DOM-based.
Unsupported format or recording failure offers a working alternate or replay download.
Both fighters and their readable wind-ups remain in frame.
Live, baseline, fallback and recorded states are distinguishable in overlays and exports.
Standard test matrix meets median16.7/p95 20/p99 33ms targets after warm-up.
Selected standard match <=48MiB and <=15s controlled cold-start target.
20 rematches and repeated selections stay within bounded memory use.
Concurrency cap comes from independent-match p95 load tests with headroom.
Context loss, resize, disconnect and abort do not strand sessions or fighters.
Origin/token/rate/body/schema/time limits pass negative tests.
Replays cannot run code or load arbitrary URLs.
No client-only score is presented as a verified global competitive result.
Publication blocks missing official source, verified date or required content reviews.
Title/asset/likeness/voice/music/font records have a reviewed usage basis.
Visible in landing, play and exported footage; no authentic-news framing.
Gameplay selection is not used to infer ideology, voting or political preference.
Avatar stats, moves and AI policies do not represent real leader competence or beliefs.
Tests, asset manifests, model report and genuine demonstration accompany the release.
